disputedClaims.claim: Galería Sixtina inaugurated Café Lumiere on 27 May 2026.
disputedClaims.detail: Asserted by an AI search summary, not reproducible in any primary source. Galería Sixtina (painter Julio Visquerra's gallery) is reported to be in Portal del Valle, and the café is in Portal del Valle, but a shared address does not establish that the gallery opened the café.

A 2026-09-23 TikTok from @valledeangeles.honduras reading 'Esperamos que pronto esté abierto de nuevo' surfaced in searches for the café, but that video's embedded page data contains no mention of Lumière. It is about a different venue. Most recent confirmed café activity is 2026-09-15.
